title: Los Alamos hiring during a nuclear arms race
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Los Alamos hiring during a nuclear arms race, about 2020s at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: She said, "There's a huge nuclear arms race going on right now, and they're building bombs like mad."

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer on UFO topics, relays what a woman connected to Los Alamos told him; Los Alamos is the US government lab in New Mexico where nuclear weapons are designed. According to her, there is a huge nuclear arms race going on right now in the 2020s, and they are building bombs like mad, which is why the lab is hiring.
